get.description:
Retrieve all models from the database.

Returns:
    List[ModelSchema]: A list of all models, including the count of adapters for each.

Raises:
    HTTPException: If no models are found in the database.

schema.title: Response Get Models V1Alpha1 Models Get

post.description:
Create a new model in the database. Remember to checkin the model
to the code repository.

Args:
    model (ModelSchema): The model data to create.

Returns:
    ModelSchema: The created model.

get.description:
Retrieve a specific model by its ID.

Args:
    id (uuid.UUID): The unique identifier of the model to retrieve.

Returns:
    ModelSchema: The requested model, including the count of its adapters.

Raises:
    HTTPException: If the model with the given ID is not found in the database.

put.description:
Update an existing model in the database.

Args:
    model (ModelSchema): The updated model data.

Returns:
    ModelSchema: The updated model.

delete.description:
Delete a model from the database.

Returns:
    dict: A message confirming the deletion.

Raises:
    HTTPException: If the model is not found or is still in use by instances.

get.description:
List all inference instances.

Args:
    db (Session): The database session, injected by FastAPI.

Args:

Returns:

get.description:
List all finetune jobs available in the cluster.

Args:
    model_id (UUID): ID of the model.

Returns:
    List[Finetune]: List of all finetune jobs.

Raises:
    HTTPException: If there's an error retrieving the finetune jobs.

schema.title: Response List Finetunes V1Alpha1 Models  Model Id  Finetune Get

post.description:
Create a new finetune job.

Args:
    model_id (UUID): ID of the model.
    finetune (FinetuneCreate): Finetune job details.

Returns:
    Finetune: Created finetune job.

Raises:
    HTTPException: If there's an error creating the finetune job.

get.description:
Get details of a specific finetune job.

Args:
    model_id (UUID): ID of the model.
    finetune_id (UUID): ID of the finetune job.

Returns:
    Finetune: Details of the finetune job.

Raises:
    HTTPException: If the finetune job is not found or there's an error retrieving it.

put.description:
Update a finetune job.

Args:
    model_id (UUID): ID of the model.
    finetune_id (UUID): ID of the finetune job to update.
    finetune (FinetuneUpdate): Updated finetune job details.

Returns:
    Finetune: Updated finetune job.

Raises:
    HTTPException: If the finetune job is not found or there's an error updating it.

delete.description:
Delete a finetune job.

Args:
    model_id (UUID): ID of the model.
    finetune_id (UUID): ID of the finetune job to delete.

Raises:
    HTTPException: If the finetune job is not found or there's an error deleting it.

get.description:
Get logs of a finetune job.

Args:
    model_id (UUID): ID of the model.
    finetune_id (UUID): ID of the finetune job.

Returns:
    str: Logs of the finetune job.

Raises:
    HTTPException: If the finetune job is not found or there's an error retrieving logs.
